text: nimittaṃ manasikaroto sārattacitto vedeti tañca ajjhosā tiṭṭhati . tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā anekā phoṭṭhabbasambhavā .pe. ārā nibbāna vuccati . dhammaṃ ñatvā sati muṭṭhā piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasikaroto sārattacitto vedeti tañca ajjhosā tiṭṭhati . tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā anekā dhammasambhavā abhijjhā ca vihesā ca cittamassūpahaññati #1 ma. ghatvā . evaṃ ācinato dukkhaṃ ārā nibbāna vuccati . [135] na so rajjati rūpesu rūpaṃ disvā paṭissato virattacitto vedeti tañca nājjhosā tiṭṭhati . yathāssa passato rūpaṃ sevato
